A new microphone, built for every voice and every instrument.

From the finely woven grille to the illuminated chrome ring.
The studio reference that adapts to whatever you record.
A multi-pattern large-diaphragm studio condenser, designed and built in Germany.

Omni, wide cardioid, cardioid, hypercardioid and figure-eight, in one capsule.

Two diaphragms, face to face. Combining their two signals is how one capsule produces five different polar patterns.
No output transformer in the path, so the sound stays open and transparent, with full, deep, unrestricted bass.

An extended, carefully balanced frequency response, consistent across every one of the five polar patterns.
Less presence hype and more honest truth, so your mix needs less fixing later.
Strong output, so your preamp stays calm and quiet.

Equal pickup all around, for rooms, choirs, ensembles and the natural ambience.

The classic vocal pattern, focused forward and rejecting the room behind it.

Front and back, deaf at the sides, for duets and mid-side stereo.
